urban_terrain.digest_method: Sorted relative file name in UTF-8, NUL, binary SHA-256 of file contents; repeat for index.json and every listed PNG.

measurements.station: 20 m along the OSM centreline selected by the stage builder.
measurements.terrain_source: The stage regional raster and the streamed sight DEMs, with the shipped urban overlay. Samples use the named stage in its own frame. No per-road formation, bridge lift, tunnel depth or route-origin triangle interpolation is included.
measurements.arcade_course: The actual smoothRoadProfile function evaluated on the bundled relative longitudinal profile. This is a game course, not a surveyed road grade.
